title: Strawberry Tart
description: MC Vanilla+Actions & Stuff inspired, all mods optional Vibrant shader-free aesthetic by QuantumCat
body:
**This is a Vanilla+ modpack built for Minecraft Java Edition.** Its core animations and visual style are inspired by Actions & Stuff, the popular animation pack for Bedrock Edition developed by Oreville Studios. Rather than making a direct 1:1 port（Well, legal issues aside… actually, I just can't, lol）, I have added details and visual adjustments on top of its smooth animation framework, boosting color saturation for a vibrant, clear, and authentically Minecraft aesthetic that looks great even without shaders, while staying true to the game’s original blocky visual identity.

![This is a peaceful savanna sunset scene from Minecraft, featuring blocky acacia trees, red poppies, and golden dusk light over rolling grassy hills.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wa5M7Ju1/images/0104539b29bd1c536653860731f670fc64d5bd1a.png)
 
**Thank you to those mod authors who are not on Modrinth!**
Thanks to [南烛Nan2uu](https://search.bilibili.com/all?vt=94025674&keyword=%E5%8D%97%E7%83%9BNan2uu&from_source=webtop_search&spm_id_from=333.1007&search_source=2) for providing the resource packs [RainbowTale~☆ v1.3](https://afdian.com/album/ce318f905cc811f0b04952540025c377/c1de3764eece11f0ad2752540025c377) and [RainbowTale's expansion - Adorable Armor v1.1](https://afdian.com/album/2fcea462d6e411edafc452540025c377/b92063245d4811edb2c452540025c377) for the modpack;
FA+Player-vJE eye patch resource pack by [freshLX](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX);
[Weskerson's 3D Spawn Eggs](https://metamods.net/resourcepacks/weskersons-3d-spawn-eggs/download) resource pack by [Weskerson](https://metamods.net/author/weskerson);
 
The modpack includes mods such as Create, Farmer's Delight, cosmetic expansion mods, Friends & Foes (which restores Mojang's scrapped mobs)... All these mods are disabled by default, allowing players to enable them freely according to their playstyle, switching between a lightweight vanilla experience and fully enriched gameplay at will. Supporting data packs are disabled by default. The included Datapack Injector mod is also disabled initially, and you need to enable it manually to activate the data pack function. Data packs are stored in the datapack folder, where you can add or remove them as needed to suit the customization requirements of different saves.

![A pot sits on the stove, next to a windmill bearing, with a cardboard box on top of it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Wa5M7Ju1/images/ca05af90ea44b52c14a3b359835d82beff02ea03.png)
 
In its default clean state, the modpack functions as a lightweight client that can join most vanilla servers without breaking the multiplayer experience. With expansion modules enabled, you can enjoy diverse gameplay including tech automation, farming and cooking, decoration building, and mob collection. It caters to fans of vanilla survival, builders, explorers, and technical players alike, balancing performance, visual quality, and playability.
